lines.english: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎤᏣᏘᏰᏃ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᏥᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎦᎨᏛ ᎤᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎬᎩ, ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎢᏣᏛᎦᏅ ᎤᏢᏨᎢ.
lines.english: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎤᏢᎬᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎩ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏪᏙᎵᏨᎩ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎠᏴᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎶᏏᎶᏛ ᎤᏲ ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
lines.english: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᏞᎩᏳ ᏥᏅᎵ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᎡᏥᎪᎥᎭ, ᎨᏣᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏴ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏲ ᏯᏆᏓᏅᏔᏩᏕᎦ.
lines.english: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎦᎶᏁᏛᏰᏃ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏓᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎠᎴᏉ ᏄᏲᎱᏒᎩ, ᎾᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎬᎾ ᎬᏅᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎷᎶᎬ ᎠᏆᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ ᎢᏥᏅᎢ.
lines.english: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
